# Outbox cycle A–B–A diagnostic

Dispatch the maintained `performance-comparison.yml` workflow with `suite=outbox` and the requested PR number; see [harness instructions](../README.md). Product and harness SHAs are pinned independently in each artifact's provenance. Existing scheduled benchmark and stress coverage remains unchanged. Historical observations below retain their original scope.

Eight cases cover synchronous/pending publishers, enabled/disabled metrics, and bounded/renewable stores. Each operation runs the actual relay cycle for 500 messages using a deterministic in-memory publisher. The pending publisher starts incomplete and completes after the cycle enters its await. Renewable stores implement `IOutboxLeaseRenewalStore`; their long lease isolates the normal publication path before renewal becomes due. Blocked-renewal correctness and duration accounting have deterministic product tests; this fixture does not substitute for loaded renewal evidence.

Build and validate both revisions before timing. Run A1, B, A2 sequentially on one ubuntu-latest VM, one fresh process per case. All phases use identical fixtures, Release, tiered compilation disabled and the same CPU affinity. The 20-second setup primer precedes 30 workload warmups and 25 measured iterations at a 1-second target. Validate elapsed workload warmup of at least 20 seconds from the BDN output. Preserve every measured value and maximum with `OutlierMode.DontRemove`, MemoryDiagnoser reports, an exact 1000-cycle allocation probe, runtime series and compilation attribution.

Keep the existing acceptance criteria: controls may drift by at most 2%; timing tolerance is 1%. A confirmed loss requires the candidate's 99.9% confidence lower bound to exceed both control upper bounds by more than 1%, with stable controls and no material measured startup transition. No-loss evidence requires the candidate upper bound within 1% of both control lower bounds. Overlap alone does not establish equivalence. Allocation gains do not offset timing losses. Report amortized cycle/renewal costs separately from per-message allocations.

Workflow completion never sets a successful PR gate. Actual per-message completion latency, loaded CPU, failure/recovery/shutdown behavior, backlog and sustained stability require appropriate additional evidence. The first INCONCLUSIVE permits one exact repeat; a second requires synthesis and an improved experiment, new causal candidate or maintainer direction. Do not trim samples or change limits after inspecting results.

The previous four-case run [34274118797](https://github.com/thomhurst/Dekaf/actions/runs/34274118797), product `29ec69c76718eab89d6babd61f2276aaaf91408e`, improved all timing points against both controls with 0 B/cycle. Local expansion then exposed extra work on the renewable-store path. The new candidate observes publisher completion independently only when a renewal actually begins, retaining the blocked-renewal completion contract without adding that observer to every publication. Exact fresh-head evidence is required after that product change.
